Confession 5:00pm Herman Zepps Sunday October 25 7:10am Rosary 7:30am Our Parish Family 9:40am Rosary 10:00am David Paul Butler This weekend October 17th18th the Church celebrates the Twentyninth Sunday in Ordinary Time As our annual election cycle nears our readings this weekend are quite providential We are reminded that citizenship is about more than taxes It is about how we live together as a community Our faith connects to our civic life The two are not separate but work together This means that being a good citizen is part of being a good Christian Citizenship becomes a way of serving others and building up the common good Our role in both Church and society are important and valuable For this reason our national Bishops Conference prepares a document for every election cycle Forming Consciences for Faithful Citizenship This document available on the website of the United States Conference of Catholic Bishops is meant to help shape political choices in light of Catholic teaching Ultimately however while we do owe legitimate civic duties to earthly governments our entire being soul and ultimate allegiance belong to God alone Just as the coin that bears Caesars image is meant to be given back to him human beings who bear the image and likeness of God are meant to be given back to Him We cannot allow the concerns of this life as important as they might be to overshadow our true homeland to which we are journeying Fall Trivia Night Tuesday October 27th at 6:30PM Join us for an evening of fun friendly competition and fellowship at our Fall Trivia Night on Tuesday October 27th beginning at 6:30PM in the Parish Social Hall Gather a team of four and put your knowledge to the test with questions covering a variety of topics Whether youre a trivia expert or just looking for an enjoyable evening with fellow parishioners everyone is welcome Please see the signup in the Narthex We hope to see you there Solemnity of All Saints November 1st This year the Solemnity of All Saints falls on Sunday November 1st As this holy day falls on a Sunday its celebration takes precedence over our regular Sunday in Ordinary Time This means that all three of our weekend Masses between October 31st November 1st will be offered for the Solemnity of All Saints as we rejoice in this feast honoring the Church Triumphant the Saints in heaven We will welcome Fr Jordan DeGuire OP as our celebrant for the weekend while I am away to participate in our Diocesan Synod Following the 10:00AM Sunday Mass you are invited to join us in the Parish Social Hall for our annual All Saints Day Party Beginning with a luncheon and potluck in the Social Hall we will then move to games for our youth in the Parish Gymnasium You are invited to come dressed as your favorite Saint Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed November 2nd Following our celebration of the Church Triumphant we turn our prayers to the Church Suffering the Holy Souls in Purgatory As the Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed falls on Monday November 2nd we will offer three special Mass times as we pray for our dearly departed loved ones Our Masses on Monday November 2nd will be at 8:00AM Noon and 5:30PM Our 5:30PM Mass will be offered at St Joseph Catholic Cemetery Reminder If you will be travelling during the October Break www.Masstimes.org is a great resource to
